name: sg-live-capture
description: Continuous microphone capture + energy-VAD, promoted verbatim from the audio-transcribe tool (v0.1.60): createCapture() delivers per-frame mono PCM + RMS from an AudioWorklet (ScriptProcessor fallback) alongside a compact continuous MediaRecorder take; createVad() is the pure utterance state machine (pre-roll, hangover, hysteresis, min/max guards). Consumers: narrated-review; audio-transcribe/live-transcribe re-pin in a future overlay.
note: Dependency-free. Behaviour identical to the tool-local originals; the frame/utterance contracts are frozen — embedders depend on them.
